description: Pipeline Flow dual layout. Unhealthy: blockers + taxonomy first. Healthy: empty blockers are VALID EMPTY, not a dead-end. Telemetry confidence is the metrics-trust/scrape confidence chip (not peer health).

panels.title: Navigation
panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Primary bus 0–4: Trust / Overview / Pipeline Diagnostics / Provider Health / Data Quality. Adjunct 5–6: Incident Workspace / Run Explorer. Current workspace is disabled (aria-current). Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions.

panels.title: Provenance
panels.description: DUX5: status-card shell (reason/action beside Status; no internal scroll). DUX4-10: Scope legend — NOW=current, RANGE=window, RUN=exact run_id (HTTP), WORKFLOW/GLOBAL=blast radius/fleet. Family: HEALTH|EXEC|EVIDENCE|IMPACT|APPLICABILITY. DUX3 scope legend: NOW/RANGE/RUN/WORKFLOW/GLOBAL. Unified context/provenance banner for 2. Runtime. Scope: workflow=$workflow, pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, run_id=$run_id, selected Grafana time range. Workflow is context/evidence unless documented otherwise; run_id is local control-plane identity context only.

options.content:
Pipeline diagnostics · Status/Health → Phase → Blockers → Action · $pipeline/$run_type/stage $stage/run $run_id
SCRAPING = execution evidence, not delivery OK. Silver/Gold zeros while scraping = Not started.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: DUX6: UNKNOWN = evidence incomplete (missing/stale/not-started/backend-error/selection). Pair with Provenance reason + action; never read as OK. DUX5: UNKNOWN = evidence incomplete (missing/stale/not-started/backend-error); pair with Provenance reason + action. Not a healthy OK. DUX4-11: NOW HEALTH only. SCRAPING/telemetry chips are EVIDENCE, not success. DUX3-10: Execution/health verdict (NOW). Not telemetry collection state. Peer SCRAPING/gap chips are EVIDENCE confidence only. Primary compact Runtime verdict for the selected pipeline/run_type scope. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. This verdict is trust-gated by Runtime Telemetry Gap: a non-zero scrape/rule gap forces Status to INCOMPLETE before selected-range zero counters are trusted. Workflow is context/evidence only; run_id is local control-plane identity context and does not filter Prometheus. Runtime Status below is an expanded first-screen mirror of this same trust-gated current-status recording rule, not an independent second verdict. Required scrape/rule evidence therefore owns the headline: green OK is impossible during a trust gap. Sole first-screen status (dual twin removed #6572). UNKNOWN — status series absent (not OK). DSA-05: state x confidence x basis x next_action; handoff data-path to DQ/Run Explorer.

panels.title: First Action
panels.description: DUX5: triage copy shortened; caveats in description; no raw endpoints. DSA-05: state -> confidence -> blockers -> handoff. No giant peer KPI wall.

options.content:
**First Action**

1. Read labelled Status + freshness.
2. Open the highest-impact evidence panel.
3. Confirm scope (pipeline/run_type/run).
4. Hand off to Run Explorer or Incident as needed.

panels.description: DUX5: Value columns labelled as Count (no bare Value # headers). Current runtime blockers. Healthy state is compact VALID_EMPTY when Status=OK. Non-empty list = localization evidence. Data-path accounting -> DQ / Run Explorer handoff, not this panel.
panels.title: Runtime Blockers

panels.description: DUX4-11: Lifecycle/telemetry EVIDENCE — use neutral phase semantics, not health-green. DUX3-10: Telemetry/scrape confidence (EVIDENCE). Not pipeline HEALTH. Do not read as run success/failure. Runtime Telemetry Gap (scrape/rule trust). 0=SCRAPING (metrics + recording rules healthy), 1=SCRAPE/RULE GAP, >=2=SCRAPE+RULE GAP, null=UNKNOWN. Not a pipeline error. When elevated, Status cannot be green OK — treat zero count panels as inconclusive and open Prometheus Targets before debugging pipeline code. Time scope: current monitoring health, not selected-range runtime evidence. UNKNOWN — metrics trust series absent (TELEMETRY_ABSENT_OR_STALE). DSA-05: telemetry confidence chip, not peer pipeline health. Treat zero count panels as inconclusive when Metrics Evidence is non-zero/UNKNOWN.

Shows each active runtime blocker recording rule with its current value for the selected pipeline/run_type where the source metric exposes run_type. Expected Empty classification: an empty table is valid only when Runtime Status is OK and Runtime Telemetry Gap is clean; otherwise it is a telemetry/selector gap that must be investigated.

defaults.noValue: No blocker rows. Trust this only when Runtime Status is OK and Telemetry Gap is clean.

Monitor Aggregate Stage Lag
panels.description: DUX6: empty chart: distinguish none observed in range vs telemetry missing; do not treat No data as healthy 0 without basis. Continuous stage lag seconds by stage for the selected pipeline and run type (Prom low-cardinality). Timeseries frame for localization; not a discrete state timeline. No run_id Prom labels.

DUX5: Value columns labelled as Count (no bare Value # headers). Shows expected vs observed stage status per entity config. Gold status is contextual: expected (scd2/append/overwrite config), disabled (gold_enabled=false), pending (run active, gold not yet written), or missing (run completed, gold=0). Aggregate stage expectedness (current/range grain as query states). Exact-run chronology lives in Run Explorer, not this board.
panels.title: Inspect Stage Expectedness

panels.description: Pipeline-level runtime error rate over last 30m. bioetl_errors_total is scoped by pipeline/stage/error_code, so this panel intentionally ignores run_type in the numerator and uses Bronze input as denominator. Thresholds align with the shipped alert rule: >=5% is WARN when the 30m Bronze denominator is >=20, >=20% is CRIT/dashboard escalation; denominator <20 or missing input telemetry renders UNKNOWN instead of false OK/CRIT. Next action: open Errors by Stage/Error Code and check failed runs/backlog/lag.
panels.title: Runtime Error Rate

panels.description: DUX6: empty chart: distinguish none observed in range vs telemetry missing; do not treat No data as healthy 0 without basis. Phase latency distribution across p50, p95, and p99 for the selected pipeline. "No phase duration samples in range" means no phase duration histogram buckets were emitted in the selected range. Possible causes: run still active, metric not emitted, or label mismatch. bioetl_phase_duration_seconds has no run_type label, so unlike pipeline duration below this panel intentionally filters by pipeline only; use run_type-scoped stage duration panels or Control Plane identity when backfill and incremental runs must not be mixed.

defaults.noValue: No phase duration samples in range

panels.description: DUX6: empty chart: distinguish none observed in range vs telemetry missing; do not treat No data as healthy 0 without basis. Pipeline duration percentiles by stage. "No terminal pipeline duration samples" means no completed pipeline runs emitted duration histogram buckets in the selected range. Possible causes: run still active, terminal metric not emitted, query label mismatch.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"(${pipeline:regex}|workflow_${pipeline:regex})",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"(${pipeline:regex}|workflow_${pipeline:regex})",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"(${pipeline:regex}|workflow_${pipeline:regex})",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

Review Runtime-owned escalation

options.content: Runtime escalation — blockers + phase evidence first; then Incident for multi-domain blast radius; Run Explorer for exact-run proof.

panels.description: DUX6: handoff copy compacted; full runbook in description/docs. DUX5: triage copy shortened; caveats in description; no raw endpoints.

Runtime-owned selected-window handoff summary from shipped 15m/30m recording rules for preflight, infrastructure, failed-run, and error-rate blockers. 0 means no condition rule is firing only when the selected runtime pipeline/run_type universe exists; UNKNOWN or telemetry gap means inconclusive. Next action: use Inspect Active Runtime Blocker Detail or the pipeline failure runbook.

targets.expr: (((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_pipeline_preflight_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_pipeline_infrastructure_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_pipeline_runs_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_runtime_error_rate_high_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_runtime_pipeline_run_type_universe{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) > bool 0))

panels.title: Monitor Pipeline Alert Conditions

panels.description: DUX6: zero/empty = none observed, Not started, or Not available — never bare success; red only for validated failure (not lifecycle zero). No-records runs detected over the last 30m for selected pipeline/run_type. This is a runtime blocker candidate when runs occurred but no records were processed. 0 is valid only when the selected runtime pipeline/run_type universe exists; telemetry gaps are inconclusive. Next action: inspect checkpoint/resume and stage expectedness. Open 0. Control Plane from the navigation bus when checkpoint/resume investigation is needed.

targets.expr: sum(((sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_pipeline_runs_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}[30m])) > 0) unless on (pipeline, run_type) (sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}[30m])) > 0))) or ((count(bioetl_runtime_pipeline_run_type_universe{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) > bool 0) * 0)

panels.title: Monitor No-Records Runs

panels.description: Adaptive memory pressure state over the last 15m. 0=OK/no active pressure, 1=WARN/runtime memory pressure active, >=2=CRIT reserved for future severity recording rules, null=UNKNOWN/missing memory telemetry. This is stage-level and intentionally ignores run_type because the metric labels are pipeline/stage/reason/monitor_mode/status. Next action: open logs and inspect checkpoint/resume pressure before retrying.
panels.title: Monitor Memory Pressure Active
Review Cross-domain handoffs

options.content: Cross-domain handoffs — Provider (deps) · DQ (rejects) · Trust (replay) · Incident (ranked triage). Preserve scope variables.

panels.description: DUX6: handoff copy compacted; full runbook in description/docs. DUX5: triage copy shortened; caveats in description; no raw endpoints.

DQ handoff only. Uses shipped 15m/30m DQ recording rules to show whether runtime symptoms may be downstream of data-quality failures. Runtime does not diagnose record-level DQ here; open Data Quality for reasons, thresholds, and Silver rejects. 0 is normal only when the selected runtime pipeline universe exists; UNKNOWN or telemetry gap means inconclusive.

targets.expr: (((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_dq_soft_threshold_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_dq_hard_fail_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_dq_critical_anomaly_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_silver_validation_failures_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_runtime_pipeline_run_type_universe{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) > bool 0))

panels.title: Inspect DQ Alert Conditions

panels.description: Control Plane / Replay Safety handoff only. Uses shipped 15m/30m recording rules for manifest, checkpoint, replay, and lineage blockers. Runtime does not decide replay/resume safety here; open Control Plane for manifest, checkpoint, and ledger evidence. 0 is normal only when the selected runtime pipeline/run_type universe exists; UNKNOWN or telemetry gap means inconclusive. Open 0. Control Plane from the navigation bus for manifest, checkpoint, and replay evidence.

targets.expr: (((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_manifest_write_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_ledger_append_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_checkpoint_incompatible_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_replay_lag_high_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_replay_drift_detected_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_lineage_refs_missing_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_runtime_pipeline_run_type_universe{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) > bool 0))

panels.title: Inspect Control-plane Alert Conditions

panels.description: Selected-pipeline provider alert handoff scoped strictly to $provider_hint. All shipped 15m/30m/1h provider recording-rule conditions are summed only for that provider label; there is no global fallback in this card. 0 is normal only when the hinted provider exists in bioetl_provider_current_status; UNKNOWN means missing provider telemetry or an unknown hint. Open Provider Health for root-cause evidence.

dataLinks.title: Open 3. Provider Health
dataLinks.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. Provider alert query may scope by $provider_hint when validated.

targets.expr: (((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_failure_rate_high_15m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_retries_exhausted_1h{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_http_error_rate_high_15m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_rate_limiter_tokens_depleted_15m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_adapter_latency_high_30m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_rate_limiter_wait_high_30m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_provider_current_status{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) > bool 0))

panels.description: GLOBAL provider-independent 30m alert addends only: adapter latency and rate-limiter wait recording rules summed cluster-wide. This is not selected-pipeline localization; use Inspect Provider Alert Conditions for $provider_hint-scoped evidence. 0 is normal only when provider telemetry exists; UNKNOWN means missing bioetl_provider_current_status anchor.

dataLinks.title: Open 3. Provider Health
dataLinks.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. GLOBAL card sums cluster-wide adapter latency and rate-limiter wait conditions.

targets.expr: ((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_adapter_latency_high_30m) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_rate_limiter_wait_high_30m) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_provider_current_status) > bool 0)

panels.title: Inspect GLOBAL Provider Alert Conditions

panels.description: Freshness evidence handoff only. Counts selected-pipeline entities older than 24h from raw data freshness telemetry; this supports source/DQ escalation and is not a Runtime execution blocker or recording-rule alert condition by itself. 0 means no stale entity when freshness telemetry is available; UNKNOWN means missing freshness telemetry.

panels.description: DUX7: Copy/Open full identity value via data:text/plain link. DUX6: prefer short run/manifest display; full value via tooltip/Copy/Open; never put full UUIDs into Prometheus labels. DUX5: show short run/manifest ids in cells where possible; full value via tooltip/Copy/Open. Do not put full UUIDs into Prometheus labels. DUX5: Value columns labelled as Count (no bare Value # headers). Compact two-column local control-plane identity table. Shows Run ID, Manifest ID, Provider.Entity [Version], Contract [Schema], Execution, execution flags, Replay [Capability.Mode], Checkpoint [Anchors], optional Composite Run, and Identity Health. Exact selected run_id wins; aggregate pipeline scope without exact run_id must not guess one manifest identity; values come from HTTP, not Prometheus labels. No data/datasource errors on this HTTP-backed card mean the BioETL Ops HTTP/control-plane backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting the card as expected empty. Fail-closed: timeout, empty, or unresolved identity/accounting must render UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/NO DATA — never a synthetic healthy zero. DSA-04: thin shell; canonical hub Run Explorer.

panels.description: DUX4-23: Collapsed by default — Run Explorer owns first-class ID/Processed Records. DUX3-26: Collapsed thin shell only. Canonical ID/Processed Records hub is Run Explorer.

panels.title: Failed Workflow Runs / Range
panels.description: Counts failed workflow runs in the selected time range. `0` means no failed workflow runs were observed in the selected window; it does not prove a workflow is currently healthy or running. This panel intentionally uses selected-range evidence, not a current-state gauge. If this count is non-zero, inspect `Workflow Run Outcomes / Range`, then continue in `2. Runtime` for execution blockers or `0. Control Plane` for terminal run and replay evidence.

panels.title: Failed Pipeline Steps / Range
panels.description: Counts failed declarative workflow steps whose `step_kind=pipeline` in the selected time range. `0` means no failed pipeline step events were observed in the selected window; it does not prove stage-level success because the metric has no stage label. Use `2. Runtime` when this panel is non-zero to locate the blocking pipeline stage or runtime error path.
